name: terrastra
description: Terrastra: an original 3D toy globe for curious kids

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/build-pages.ts
scripts.test:static: VITE_STATIC=1 BASE_PATH=/terrastra/ npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.static.config.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.research:crawl: cd research && mkdir -p data screenshots/static && node scripts/crawl-static.mjs
scripts.research:explore: cd research && mkdir -p data screenshots/app && node scripts/explore-app.mjs
